chosen_after: Initial native-wheel baseline and software/native GPU trials, before final candidate acceptance runs
conditions: macOS arm64 Apple M1, isolated Chromium 153, ANGLE Metal, 1440x1080 DPR1, no artificial CPU/network throttle, warmed camera samples
limits: First observed CSS transform/draw is a browser proxy, not physical input-to-photon latency.
Synthetic trusted wheel input does not certify every physical wheel/trackpad or universal 60FPS.
Retain SwiftShader frame-target misses; native GPU figures do not erase them.
Canvas fallback is checked separately; its CPU repaint costs may miss the native-GPU frame target.
These targets concern local candidate and subsequent actual-host acceptance, not historical/geographic completeness.
